=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 158-163 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_option_weakens_control` does not expand contracted negations, so contracted weakening options can be treated as safe and selected directly or as fallbacks.
  WHY: Such answers can reach the answer poster without escalation, bypassing required security verification.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:line 73 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The passive weakening pattern misses negated verification wording such as “will not be verified” because its verb alternatives omit `verif\w*`.
  WHY: A verification-bypass option can pass the guard and reach the answer poster without escalation.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 50-82 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The weakening patterns do not detect “no longer required” phrasing.
  WHY: A selected option or fallback can waive required verification without triggering escalation; severity was reported as MAJOR by four reviewers and BLOCKER by openai_gpt-6-luna.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:line 77 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The do-not weakening pattern omits `does not` and `did not`, allowing those negated weakening statements to pass as safe.
  WHY: A verification-bypass option can reach the answer poster without escalation; severity was reported as MAJOR by z-ai_glm-5_2 and BLOCKER by minimax_minimax-m3.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 158-161 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Negation stripping handles only `do not|don't|never`, so safe control-preserving options such as “Does not skip verification” are classified as weakening.
  WHY: The guard escalates a valid answer to `ai:blocked`, requiring unnecessary human intervention.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:after line 82 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: No weakening pattern detects bare modal-negation wording such as “Would not be verified” when it has no preceding control noun.
  WHY: Such an option can pass the guard without escalation and bypass verification.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 168-172; 197-202 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_required_data_present` returns False when an option mentions a PR URL that is absent, even if alternative requested evidence such as a commit SHA is present.
  WHY: An option offering a URL-or-SHA alternative is unnecessarily escalated when the supplied SHA satisfies the alternative.
- tests/test_clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 98-112 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Regression tests for contracted weakening and passive-wording bypass cases are missing from the weakening-fallback parametrized cases.
  WHY: CI can pass without catching regressions that allow contracted weakening options through; severity was reported as MAJOR by google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and BLOCKER by minimax_minimax-m3.
- tests/test_clarify_data_provision_guard.py:lines 143-148 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Contracted control-preserving options are missing from the control-preserving parametrized cases.
  WHY: CI can pass while safe contracted options are falsely classified as weakening and escalated.

  PROBLEM: The patterns miss contracted negations such as “isn't,” “won't,” and “doesn't,” and passive-voice bypass wording such as “will not be performed” and “is not being performed.”
  WHY: These options can pass `_option_weakens_control` and let an auto-responder bypass required security or verification controls.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:158-161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5

  WHY: Safe control-preserving options can be escalated to `ai:blocked`.
- scripts/clarify_data_provision_guard.py:197-202 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_required_data_present` fails early when the URL check fails, even if other evidence such as a SHA satisfies the option.
  WHY: The guard unnecessarily escalates when alternative evidence is supplied.
- tests/test_clarify_data_provision_guard.py:98-112, 143-148 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Regression tests for contraction-based bypass cases are missing.
  WHY: Future regressions in contraction handling or passive-wording detection will not be caught by CI.

  Evidence of absence: The working tree lacks the `_CONTRACTION_EXPANSIONS` dictionary, the verb expansion in the passive pattern, and the expanded do-not regex, despite the previous run's editor claiming the implementation was successfully applied.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
